findings: `components` and `learner.components`: add a cited whole-graph pictorial component for the received interpretation of 了 as 子 without arms, marked disputed, with a matching brief learner card. Keep the crossed/entangled-legs interpretation distinct in expert prose. The received analysis is supported by E3 and X-9ea43beaa893e023c60d; the evidence explicitly treats it as interpretation rather than confirmation of an early referent.

`learner.overview`: explain the proposed sound-loan mechanism: the sign may have been reused for “finish” because the old word for the depicted form sounded alike or similar, while that old name and sound match remain unverified. “A proposed sound-based link” does not tell learners why an image could write an unrelated word. Cite the explanation and limitation to E4, X-a393f71b628dadc704ac, and X-b0e2878f58b585c8a888.
